outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart of HMGB1 signal intensity (mean ± SD) but shows only bars with error bars, no individual data points overlaid despite reporting N=4, n>100 measurements.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (mean ± SD, N=4, n>400) with no individual data points shown.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot showing rotarod performance over time; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days at different weeks); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot type, which is exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel G contains only micrograph images, no plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel H contains two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, mean ± SD, N=3, n=9) with no individual data points overlaid on the bars.
